thread:
emma: Repro: console creates key as org-level when project lookup RPC is slow. Saw this with a customer today.
raj: can you share the minimal payload and logs?
emma: payload: POST /api/keys {"org_id":"org:acme", "project_id":"proj:alpha", "sa_id":"sa:ingest" } but logs show project-lookup 504 then write with project_id=null.
kevin: pattern seems to be auth-proxy timeout -> fallback to org create. Billing/quotas teams are confused. we should make the console and API explicit about fallback.
sara: proposal: API returns header X-Create-Reason: ok|fallback_timeout|explicit_org. Console shows an inline warning when reason!=ok and requires a confirm. also emit telemetry event key.create.reason sampled at 1%.
emma: UX text draft: "We couldn't verify the project due to a timeout. The key was created at org level and may not be subject to project quotas. Convert to project key if needed"
raj: conversion endpoint: POST /api/keys/:id/convert { project_id } — requires org-admin or key-owner and writes audit:convert.
kevin: rollout: feature-flag header as auth.create_reason, enable in canary, dashboard card: projectless-key rate + auth-proxy 5xx correlation. alert if projectless_rate > 0.4% over 30m.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature flag auth.create_reason -> eng-plat-canary at 2024-04-15T08:00:00Z.
sara: I'll add the telemetry PR and the dashboard. raj: I'll implement header and convert endpoint spec.emma: thanks team, ping legal for audit wording. :thumbsup:
